mechanism_narrative: Consistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods with FEDFUNDS < 0.5% are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 265.0 signals inflationary pressure that triggers central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in < 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 265.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and consumer price index (CPIAUCSL < 265.0) indicates accommodative real rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in interaction-triggered periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1 > 20000) and robust labor market (PAYEMS > 140000) define late-cycle expansion, where S&P 500 forward returns are positive over the next 20 trading days due to sustained economic momentum.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in < 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% (UNRATE > 5.0) signals deteriorating labor market conditions that depress corporate earnings expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in < 40% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing output contraction (INDPRO < 100.0) indicates supply chain stress and economic slowdown, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in < 40% of instances where INDPRO < 100.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1600.0 (HOUST > 1600.0) signal strong residential demand, indicating economic resilience and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in < 60% of instances where HOUST > 1600.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent decline in housing starts (HOUST < 1600.0) and residential sales (RSAFS < 560000.0) indicates housing market contraction, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in < 40% of interaction-triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
